build_QualityFocalLoss: build a QualityFocalLoss module with configurable beta and reduction for dense object detection
build_DistributionFocalLoss: build a DistributionFocalLoss module for learning distributed bounding box regression in detection
run_quality_focal_loss: run quality_focal_loss to compute QFL from logits, category labels, and IoU quality scores
run_quality_focal_loss_tensor_target: run quality_focal_loss_tensor_target to compute QFL using tensor targets with soft weights
run_distribution_focal_loss: run distribution_focal_loss to compute DFL from predicted distribution and target distance labels
